recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No FHIR-39386 follow-up is needed in the current core source; any future Contract removal should be handled under FHIR-55563 or another applied/published issue once it is in scope.
issue_request: FHIR-39386 was Published and resolved Persuasive with Modification for R5. It requested adding missing resources with patient or subject-equivalent search parameters to the Patient compartment, specifically Task.patient, Task.focus, Contract.patient, and GuidanceResponse.patient.
initial_application: Commit 49328521fcc745d1d17b58456d31234829f71a88 explicitly applied FHIR-39386 in source/compartments.xml, adding Contract.patient, GuidanceResponse.patient, and Task.patient | focus to rows that previously lacked Patient-compartment search parameters.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes CompartmentDefinition, Contract, GuidanceResponse, and Task, so the checked compartment spreadsheet and search-parameter bundles are current build inputs. Later Task search-parameter work split Task.focus into focus-reference and focus-canonical; commit b6998e4d301b75c18e4144fc8eadfda2d7bcd7f7 updated the compartment row to patient | focus-reference. FHIR-55563 proposes pulling Contract from R6, but it is only Resolved - change required and its Branch_55563 commit is not on the combined branch, so it is background for this default Applied/Published reconciliation.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. Current source/compartments.xml lists Contract with patient, GuidanceResponse with patient, and Task with patient | focus-reference in the Patient column, and the corresponding Contract-patient, GuidanceResponse-patient, Task-patient, and Task-focus-reference search parameters exist.

related_jiras.note: Resolved - change required issue to pull Contract from R6; its branch is not on the combined branch and it is outside this default Applied/Published seed decision.
